p.i: spectu[?], quemadmodum reieci vestros omnes fratres, scilicet omnem Ephraimi progeniem. Ierem.7.

Sic dicit armipotens Iova, Deus Israelitarum, omnibus exulibus, quos ipse Hierosolymis in Babyloniam relegavit. Ædificate quas habitetis domos, & hortos, quorum fructu vescamini, conserite: ducite uxores, liberosq; gignite, & filiis vestris uxores capite, & filias nuptum locate, quae liberos pariant, atq; ibi crescite, neve decrescite, & salutistudete[?] urbis, quò vos ego relegavi, Iovam q; pro ea orate: nam in ejus salute vobis sita salus est. Ierem.29.

Item me affatus est his verbis Iova: Tu vero, homo, scilicet patrocineris, sci-licet patrocineris urbi cruenta[?]simò ei demōstra ejus tot scelera, & dicito: Sic dicit Dominus Iova: O urbs q[?] in medio tui sanguine fudisti, ut tuū tempus veniat, ster-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the opening word of the first line is cut at the edge ("spectu[?]"). "cruenta[?]simò" is hard to read; the printed form may be a single word or a split one. "q[?]" before "in medio" carries a mark over the q that I could not resolve. "salutistudete[?]" is a line-end break with no visible hyphen. The line ending "ster-" keeps its printed hyphen; the word continues on the next page. The running head "NVPTIALES." is normalised to "NUPTIALES." per the u/v rule.
